scientific_integrity: An exact algebraic proof is given; independently implemented exhaustive finite-state computations corroborate it at n=2..7. No independent scientific audit or validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the fixed nonsink hub source, hub sink, uniform recurrent initial states, and total toppling count on K_{3,n}, n>=2. Broader exact avalanche formulas under other forms could affect historical priority. The asymptotic limit is a two-atom conditional law, not a scale-free critical exponent.
title: Two macroscopic avalanche bands on a three-hub bipartite sandpile
